Subject: Evidence export: credentialed split delivery plan

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the SOC 2 evidence request. To make the delivery as low-friction as possible for your audit team, Redwood can do a two-stage export: 1) a signed metadata/manifest (file list + checksums + HMAC) and 2) the bulk admin-activity bundles. A few quick questions so we can size and schedule the job: 

- Preferred transport: TLS SFTP with a scoped user, or S3 presigned URLs?
- Scope: rolling 90 days? Or a fixed window (start/end timestamps)?
- Granularity: do you need tenant-separated bundles (separate file per tenant) or combined with tenant ID in records?
- Compliance ask: do you require HMAC-signed manifest and SHA-256 checksums?

We can provide a brief runbook and a sample manifest schema for validation before the transfer. If you want, we can do an initial 7-day validation export to confirm checksums and the transfer process.

Proposed timeline: once transport and scope are agreed, we can schedule an initial validation export within 48 hours and full transfer within your requested window.

Looping in Kim (tech lead) to confirm the runbook and manifest layout.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: export_runbook_draft.md (draft), sample_manifest_schema.json (schema stub)

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmecloud.com>

Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00

Ben — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below: 

- Transport: our security team prefers TLS SFTP with a dedicated account and key-based auth. S3 presigned is acceptable as fallback but needs to be one-time URLs and encrypted in transit.
- Scope: full 90 days historical window (2026-07-11 — 2026-10-09) for admin activity.
- Granularity: we need tenant-separated bundles (one archive per tenant) plus a combined index manifest.
- Signing/checksums: we require SHA-256 checksums for each bundle and an HMAC-signed manifest. Please include a manifest signature method description.

Additionally, our procurement/legal requires a transfer addendum (DocuSign) for off-platform exports. I copied audit@acmecloud.com for the compliance queue.

If you can do a 7-day rolling validation export for a small tenant before the full pull, that would be ideal.

Jordan Ellis
Principal, Cloud Compliance — AcmeCloud

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence export: credentialed split delivery plan

Ben / Monica — good plan. Technical notes and proposed procedure below.

1) Manifest & signing
- Manifest schema: index.jsonl (newline-delimited JSON) with fields: tenant_id, bundle_name, sha256, size_bytes, created_at. See attached sample_manifest_schema.json.
- HMAC: we'll generate an ephemeral HMAC key from our KMS and create a wrapped key package (RSA-OAEP) to share with Acme's public key. Key rotation: ephemeral key per export day.

2) Transport
- Primary: TLS SFTP (dedicated system user: redwood_acme_export, key-based auth). Provide public key exchange for their SFTP server.
- Fallback: S3 presigned PUT URLs encrypted via SSE-S3; presigned links will be one-time and expire in 24 hours.

3) Bundling
- We'll emit per-tenant tar.gz files named tenant_<id>_admin_YYYYMMDD.tar.gz. Each archive will include an internal manifest detail file.
- We'll also produce combined index.jsonl.gz for their audit team.

4) Retention & redaction
- We will produce logs for the requested 90-day window. Note: privileged-access PII is redacted by default; if Acme requires full PII, we need a signed data-use agreement.

5) Validation cadence
- Step A: single-tenant 7-day validation (test tenant id T-VAL).
- Step B: once validated, full 90-day export scheduled off hours (UTC 0200–0500) to minimise impact.

6) Checksums and attestation
- SHA-256 for each bundle; manifest HMAC (HMAC-SHA256). We will provide signed_manifest.sha256 (ASCII-armored).

Quote of Jordan for clarity:
> "we require SHA-256 checksums for each bundle and an HMAC-signed manifest"

I'll prepare the runbook and the key-wrapping instructions. Monica — can you schedule a maintenance window and create the redwood_acme_export user on our SFTP gateway? Also confirm whether we need to rotate keys midway through the 90-day transfer.

Kimberly Park
Tech Lead, Operator Experience
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: sample_manifest_schema.json)
